# Step-by-step network construction

This archived report documents the step-by-step form of the
`run_network_construction()` programmatic API. It constructs full adjacency and
TOM matrices and is substantially more memory intensive than blockwise
construction. Advanced users should call the function directly from R code.

## Construct the network

```{r}
network_report <- run_network_construction(
  session_dir = session_dir,
  method = "stepwise",
  tom_type = "auto",
  correlation_type = "pearson",
  merge_cut_height = 0.30,
  deep_split = 2,
  min_module_size = 30,
  random_seed = 42,
  kmeans_refinement = TRUE,
  save_adjacency = TRUE
)

network_report
```

## Module counts and TOM artifacts

```{r}
network_report$module_counts
network_report$tom
```

The standardized network is stored in `out/3_networks.rds`. The TOM manifest
records both the RDS matrix and the legacy `TOM` RData file.
